Latin word

intervallum

intervallum, intervallī n.

noun, second declension

the distance between, an interval; a gap in time; a gap, the space between two things

In this lexicon

  • distance

    also used · classical · Caes. B.G. 1.43.2: parī intervallō; Liv. 23.29: quīnque mīlium intervallō (Lewis & Short)

  • space

    also used · classical · Caes. BG 7.23.1: paribus intervallīs (Lewis & Short)

Notes

  1. 1intervallum: a left unmarked. Lewis & Short marks neither vallum nor intervallum, and de Vaan (s.v. vallum) reconstructs *walso- without ruling on the vowel. The loci collection prints intervāllō in Liv. 22.12.8; the length is not settled here.
